protocol.selection: Held-out episodes 1,2,3 visually show real grasp, transport and ball deposited in bowl. Local diagnostic review; original unknown outcome annotations unchanged.
protocol.duration: Every 10Hz tick through the final recorded frame; replay-only horizon extended, all safety/action/velocity/contact settings unchanged.
protocol.objects: Ball and bowl initialized from existing first-frame image evidence using fixed camera; then ball is fully dynamic, never attached or reset.
protocol.reference: Unclipped recorded joints posed without physics for visual and FK comparison; limit violations explicitly counted. Not a grasp feasibility or success test.
protocol.cartesian: Recorded achieved Cartesian deltas, applied relative to actual current pose; next recorded follower gripper for matched jaw motion. leader_gripper variant alone uses unchanged policy-label gripper commands.
protocol.feedback: Privileged next recorded absolute pose converted to bounded Cartesian delta, with polished IK. Tests accumulated execution error; not a learned policy or changed label.
protocol.jaw_gap: Distance between fixed/moving sph_tip1 sphere surfaces. A reproducible aperture proxy, not measured real jaw clearance.
protocol.contact: All 500Hz physics substeps inspected before integration; task success/lift scored using unchanged 10Hz TrialTracker.
protocol.images: Exact recorded source frames at derived frame indices. Overlaid jaw tips use fixed camera; no per-frame fit. Ball centroid is a 2-D color detection and not a measured 3-D trajectory.
protocol.phases: Coarse reviewed closure/lift-transport/release windows; boundaries approximate and independent of simulated outcome.
